tools.name: query
tools.description: Search for verified method contracts for any library. Pass any text -- library name, method, what you're building, or an error you hit.

query.description: What are you looking for? A method name, a library, an error message, or what you're building. Examples: s3 put_object, auto_gptq import, pandas merge, ImportError peft.

error_type.description: (deprecated -- use query instead) Error type if searching by error

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all libraries and services that have verified method contracts. Use this first to discover what's available, then query for specific methods.

tools.name: list_methods
tools.description: List all methods for a given library or service. Use after list_services to drill into a specific one.

service.description: Library or service name. Get these from list_services first.

tools.name: policy
tools.description: Generate a least-privilege IAM policy for an AWS workflow. Pass a named workflow, explicit IAM actions, or a description. Returns the exact policy with confidence tier and any unresolved operations.

operations.description: Explicit IAM action strings or SDK symbols, comma-separated (e.g. 's3:PutObject,s3:GetObject')

description.description: Describe the workflow (e.g. 'upload a large file to S3 with KMS')

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List the curated named workflows that can generate least-privilege IAM policies.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Feed a generated policy back to AWS's own policy evaluation engine (SimulateCustomPolicy) and confirm it grants exactly the intended operations and nothing extra. Returns verified (True|False|unknown), grants_all, grants_extra. Requires AWS credentials; without them verified=unknown with the reason. Wildcarded operations are expanded to concrete actions first.

workflow.description: A named workflow from list_workflows to generate and then verify

operations.description: Intended IAM actions, comma-separated. Required if policy is provided.

policy.description: Optional. A complete IAM policy JSON document to verify.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Pre-flight authorization check for an AWS operation. Resolves the IAM actions the operation requires, then asks AWS's own policy simulator (SimulatePrincipalPolicy) whether the current role (or a given principal) allows them. Returns resolution (exact|partial|unresolved) and evaluation (allowed|denied|unknown) as separate fields. Requires AWS credentials; without them evaluation=unknown with the reason.

operations.description: IAM action strings or SDK symbols, comma-separated (e.g. 's3:PutObject' or 's3.PutObject')

principal_arn.description: Optional. IAM role/user ARN to simulate against. Defaults to the current caller via sts:GetCallerIdentity.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register a fix. Three actions: confirm (it worked), append_thread (variant worked), new_receipt (nothing matched, I fixed it).
